rev.t: The books are excessively priced relative to their page count. Despite a purchase totaling approximately Rs 5K , no discount was offered, not even a single rupee. Other retailers provide significant discounts. Therefore, I advise against purchasing anything from this establishment.
Worst book store they don't value people time, they mind only money!!

If you are planning to visit this place, think twice. They aren't open at all time. Neither they will answer your calls. So you will get to buy here only if you are lucky. There is no way to know when they are open or closed.
